technique_name: What is an example of a real-world application of a neural network?
description: One example of a real-world application of a neural network is image classification. Neural networks can be used to classify images by recognizing landmarks and objects in the images. For example, it can be used for facial recognition to detect the facial features of a person’s face. It can also be used for identifying medical images such as X-rays and MRI scans, as well as for recognizing objects and identifying handwriting.
